items.source: Marker interface for Spring Data EvaluationContext extensions.
items.translation: Spring Data 用于扩展 EvaluationContext 的标记接口。

items.source: Return the identifier of the extension.

Return the identifier of the extension. The id can be leveraged by users to fully qualify property lookups and thus
overcome ambiguities in case multiple extensions expose properties with the same name.
items.translation: 返回扩展的标识符。用户可利用该 id 对属性查找进行完全限定，从而在多个扩展暴露同名属性的情况下消除歧义。
